findings.explanation: With no type definitions, Lean gives the same result for the ID lists `[true]` and `[false]`. Both calls reduce to the same `ARB`. HOL4 specifies the empty/empty and cons/cons cases only. Its equations allow those two mismatched calls to return different lists.
findings.repair:
private opaque type_def_to_ctMap_unmatched {α β γ : Type} (tenvT : Namespace mlstring mlstring (List mlstring × typ)) (next : Nat) (tds : List (α × β × List (conN × List ast_t))) (ids : List γ) : List (stamp × (α × List typ × γ))

def type_def_to_ctMap {α β γ : Type}
    (tenvT : Namespace mlstring mlstring (List mlstring × typ)) :
    Nat → List (α × β × List (conN × List ast_t)) → List γ → List (stamp × (α × List typ × γ))
  | _, [], [] => []
  | next, (tvs, _, ctors) :: tds, id :: ids =>
    type_def_to_ctMap tenvT (next + 1) tds ids ++
      (ctors.map (fun (cn, ts) => (TypeStamp cn next, (tvs, ts.map (type_name_subst tenvT), id)))).reverse
  | next, tds, ids => type_def_to_ctMap_unmatched tenvT next tds ids
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.TypeSysProps
open CmlTS

example (env : Namespace mlstring mlstring (List mlstring × typ)) :
    type_def_to_ctMap (α := Unit) (β := Unit) env 0 [] [true] =
    type_def_to_ctMap (α := Unit) (β := Unit) env 0 [] [false] := rfl

findings.explanation: HOL4’s builder copies each ID into a constructor entry, and `tenv_ctor_ok` ignores that field. The ID type and the output namespace’s module-name type are independently polymorphic. For example, HOL4 permits Boolean IDs and Boolean module names. Lean fixes `tis` to `List type_ident` and the builder’s output to `tenv_ctor`, whose module names have type `modN`. The theorem therefore covers only a special case.
findings.repair:
private def buildCtorTenvPoly {m ι : Type} (tenvT : Namespace modN typeN (List tvarN × typ)) :
    List (List tvarN × mlstring × List (conN × List ast_t)) → List ι →
      Namespace m conN (List tvarN × List typ × ι)
  | (tvs, _, ctors) :: tds, id :: ids =>
    nsAppend (buildCtorTenvPoly tenvT tds ids)
      (alist_to_ns (ctors.map (fun (cn, ts) => (cn, (tvs, ts.map (type_name_subst tenvT), id)))).reverse)
  | _, _ => alist_to_ns []

theorem check_ctor_tenv_ok {m ι : Type} :
    ∀ (tenvT : Namespace modN typeN (List tvarN × typ))
      (tds : List (List tvarN × mlstring × List (conN × List ast_t))) (tis : List ι),
      tds.length = tis.length ∧ check_ctor_tenv tenvT tds ∧ tenv_abbrev_ok tenvT →
      tenv_ctor_ok (buildCtorTenvPoly (m := m) tenvT tds tis) := by
  sorry
findings.hol4_check: ∀tenvT tds (tis : bool list). LENGTH tds = LENGTH tis ∧ check_ctor_tenv tenvT tds ∧ tenv_abbrev_ok tenvT ⇒ tenv_ctor_ok (build_ctor_tenv tenvT tds tis : (bool, conN, tvarN list # t list # bool) namespace)
